latest_release.name: v5.38.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat(alerting): add Resend alerting provider by @geffersonFerraz in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1830
* fix(maintenance): validate maintenance windows for external, DNS and SSH endpoints by @anandghegde in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1804
* fix(alerting): Redact telegram token from errors on send failure by @hippi345 in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1843
* fix(websocket): apply the client timeout to reads and writes by @somaz94 in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1845
* fix(ssh): support keyboard-interactive authentication for endpoints and tunnels by @peckto in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1863
* fix(security): add comprehensive logging and diagnostics for OIDC (#1802) by @tech00exploere in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1862
* fix(jsonpath): support object keys containing dots via quoted accessors by @leotemtem in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1864
* fix: Honor minimum-reminder-interval for external endpoints by @yzxcj797 in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1773
* chore(alerting): restyle matrix alerts with errors, safe links and escaping by @mazzz1y in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1875

## New Contributors
* @anandghegde made their first contribution in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1804
* @yzxcj797 made their first contribution in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1773

* @tech00exploere made their first contribution in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1862
* @leotemtem made their first contribution in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1864
* @mazzz1y made their first contribution in https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/pull/1875

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/TwiN/gatus/compare/v5.37.0...v5.38.0
